name: Power Sources
description: Every Create network needs at least one source of rotation.

pages.title: Power Sources
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Every network needs at least one **source** of rotation.
- Small and simple: Hand Crank, Water Wheel, Windmill (with **Windcatchers**, not Create sails).
- Big jobs: **Large Water Wheel** and **Steam Engine**.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Blaze burners and engines make pollution here.

Every Create [#](7A3C9A)[network](entry://glossary/kinetic_network)[#]() needs at least one source of rotation. They differ in how much capacity they give, how fast they spin, and how much setup they take.

pages.title: Hand Crank
pages.text: You power it. Hold Use to rotate one way, sneak and hold Use for the other. Useful for testing and tiny jobs.

pages.title: Water Wheel
pages.text: Takes force from adjacent flowing water. Extra sides in water do not add output. Low capacity, steady.

pages.title: Large Water Wheel
pages.text: Spins at half the speed of a normal wheel, but gives a much higher [#](2E5AAC)[stress capacity](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]().

pages.title: Windmill Bearing
pages.text: Spins the structure in front of it. Here only [#](2E5AAC)[Windcatchers](entry://flight/wind_sailing)[#]() drive it; Create sails and wool are decoration. Needs at least 8, open air and [#](7A3C9A)[glue](entry://glossary/super_glue)[#](). It turns at wind speed; more Windcatchers add [#](2E5AAC)[capacity](entry://create_basics/stress)[#](), up to 8,192 SU.

pages.title: Windmill Sail
pages.text: Place on a sail frame or any block. Right-click with dye to colour, shears turn it back to a frame. On a windmill bearing it is decoration here.

pages.title: Windcatcher
pages.text: The sail that powers windmills here: 2 from sticks, string and white wool. Place them on the bearing's structure like sails, broad side into the wind. Wind is faster over open ocean and up high. See [#](2E5AAC)[Sailing and Wind](entry://flight/wind_sailing)[#]().

**Steam Engine.** Sits on a [#](7A3C9A)[boiler](entry://glossary/boiler)[#]() built from **Fluid Tanks**.

- Needs water and heat from a **Blaze Burner**.
- A minimal boiler is 4 tanks.
- Heat more and it reaches a higher power level. Each level lets one more engine run at full strength.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show the level.

pages.title: Steam Engine
pages.text: Connect a shaft to the engine's output. Heat comes from a blaze burner under the boiler. See [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Fluids](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]().
A 4-tank boiler over Blaze Burners, filled with water. The shaft goes on the engine's output.

Blaze burners and engines make [#](2E5AAC)[pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#]() in this pack. The Creative Motor exists but is not obtainable in survival.\
\
Add-ons bring more sources: [#](2E5AAC)[Electricity](entry://industry/electricity)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Liquid Fuel](entry://industry/liquid_fuel)[#]().
